name: egress
purpose: The one door to the network: allow-listed https hosts, named purposes, recorded
usedFor: Every network call app code makes: webhooks, the weather service, campus services, sign-in keys. Each names its purpose and goes only to a host the app declared. `routedEgress` runs services in-process behind the same door; `EgressTwin` records without leaving the machine.
notFor: Model calls (they go through the models block), inbound requests, or retry policy (callers decide; writes use idempotency keys and are verified).
